title: Kraken2 Classification Reports Per Sample
description: Kraken2 classification reports for each sample within a group, as produced by the RUN workflow and concatenated by the DOWNSTREAM workflow. Classification is performed on a configurable number of subsampled reads per sample (default 1 million; controlled by params.n_reads_profile in the RUN configuration, recorded in input/params-run.json in the output directory). Reads are split into putative ribosomal and non-ribosomal sets before classification; the ribosomal column indicates which set each row's results come from.

fields.name: pc_reads_total
fields.title: Percentage of Total Reads
fields.description: Percentage of total reads rooted at this taxon.

fields.name: n_reads_clade
fields.title: Clade Read Count
fields.description: Number of reads assigned to the clade rooted at this taxon.

fields.name: n_reads_direct
fields.title: Direct Read Count
fields.description: Number of reads assigned directly to this taxon.

fields.name: n_minimizers_total
fields.title: Total Minimizers
fields.description: Total number of minimizers associated with this taxon, counted once per k-mer: a minimizer shared by consecutive k-mers of a read counts once for each. Kraken2 versions before 2.17.2 counted each run of consecutive identical minimizers once, giving lower values.

fields.name: n_minimizers_distinct
fields.title: Distinct Minimizers
fields.description: Number of distinct minimizers associated with this taxon.

fields.name: rank
fields.title: Taxonomic Rank
fields.description: Taxonomic rank code (e.g. R for root, D for domain, S for species). Nodes at ranks other than domain, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus and species take the code of their nearest coded ancestor plus their depth below it (e.g. R1 for Viruses in the current NCBI taxonomy, D1 for nodes just below a domain).

fields.name: taxid
fields.title: Taxonomy ID
fields.description: NCBI taxonomy ID for the taxon.

fields.name: sample
fields.title: Sample
fields.description: Sample identifier from the RUN workflow.

fields.name: ribosomal
fields.title: Ribosomal
fields.description: Indicates which read set this row's classification comes from. Reads are split into putative ribosomal (TRUE) and non-ribosomal (FALSE) sets before taxonomic profiling, and classified independently.

fields.name: group
fields.title: Group
fields.description: Group identifier assigned to this sample in the grouping TSV.
